source: Actual local Standard TCG corpus, not synthetic discovery data

abilities.name: Solar Transfer
abilities.effect: As often as you like during your turn, you may use this Ability. Move a Basic {G} Energy from 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Jungle Dump
attacks.effect: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Poison Powder
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Push Down
attacks.effect: Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

abilities.name: Wild Growth
abilities.effect: Each Basic {G} Energy attached to all of your Pokémon provides {G}{G} Energy. The effect of Wild Growth doesn't stack.

attacks.name: Supernatural Shapeshifter
attacks.effect: Discard the top card of your deck, and if that card is a Supporter card, use the effect of that card as the effect of this attack.

attacks.name: Coiling Crush
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Riptide
attacks.effect: This attack does 20 damage for each Basic {W} Energy card in your discard pile. Then, shuffle those cards into your deck.

attacks.name: Swirling Waves
attacks.effect: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hide
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

abilities.name: Fragile Husk
abilities.effect: If this Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon ex, your opponent can't take any Prize cards for it.

attacks.name: Damage Beat
attacks.effect: This attack does 20 damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Aura Jab
attacks.effect: Attach up to 3 Basic {F} Energy cards from your discard pile to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Mega Brave
attacks.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Mega Brave.

attacks.name: Stony Kick
attacks.effect: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Boundless Power
attacks.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use attacks.

abilities.name: Spiteful Swirl
abilities.effect: If your Active {D} Pokémon is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if your Active {D} Pokémon is Knocked Out), place 1 damage counter on the Attacking Pokémon.

attacks.name: Mountain Breaker
attacks.effect: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Pluck
attacks.effect: Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tools from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

card.name: Lt. Surge's Bargain
card.effect: Ask your opponent if each player may take a Prize card. If yes, each player takes a Prize card. If no, you draw 4 cards.

card.name: Strange Timepiece
card.effect: Devolve 1 of your evolved {P} Pokémon by putting any number of Evolution cards on it into your hand. (That Pokémon can't evolve this turn.)

card.name: Night Stretcher
card.effect: Put a Pokémon or a Basic Energy card from your discard pile into your hand.

card.name: Mamoswine
card.description: A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time.

attacks.name: Wreck
attacks.effect: If a Stadium is in play, this attack does 120 more damage. Then, discard that Stadium.

attacks.name: Blizzard Edge
attacks.effect: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

card.name: Budew
card.description: The pollen it releases contains poison. If this Pokémon is raised on clean water, the poison’s toxicity is increased.

attacks.name: Itchy Pollen
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, they can't play any Item cards from their hand.

attacks.name: Snow Coating
attacks.effect: Double the number of damage counters on each of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Blizzard
attacks.effect: This attack also does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

abilities.name: Fairy Zone
abilities.effect: The Weakness of each of your opponent's {N} Pokémon in play is now {P}. (Apply Weakness as ×2.)

attacks.name: Full Moon Rondo
attacks.effect: This attack does 20 more damage for each Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).

card.name: Munkidori
card.description: Munkidori keeps itself somewhere safe while it toys with its foes, using psychokinesis to induce intense dizziness.

abilities.name: Adrena-Brain
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon has any {D} Energy attached, you may move up to 3 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Mind Bend
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

abilities.name: Double Type
abilities.effect: As long as this Pokémon is in play, it is {F} and {P} type.

attacks.name: Counter Jewel
attacks.effect: If your opponent has 2 or fewer Prize cards remaining, this attack does 100 more damage.

card.name: Scraggy
card.description: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

attacks.name: Knock Off
attacks.effect: Discard a random card from your opponent's hand.

card.name: Counter Gain
card.effect: If you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent, attacks used by the Pokémon this card is attached to cost {C} less.

card.name: Team Rocket's Watchtower
card.effect: {C} Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) have no Abilities.

card.name: Budew
card.description: The pollen it releases contains poison. If this Pokémon is raised on clean water, the poison’s toxicity is increased.

attacks.name: Itchy Pollen
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, they can't play any Item cards from their hand.

card.name: Jamming Tower
card.effect: Pokémon Tools attached to each Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) have no effect.

card.name: Phantump
card.description: According to old tales, these Pokémon are stumps possessed by the spirits of children who died while lost in the forest.

abilities.name: Spiteful Evolution
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Choose a card in your hand that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. If you do, place 2 damage counters on the Pokémon you evolved in this way. You can't use this Ability during your first turn.

card.name: Iron Thorns
card.description: Some of its notable features match those of an object named within a certain expedition journal as Iron Thorns.

attacks.name: Destructo-Press
attacks.effect: Reveal the top 5 cards of your deck. This attack does 70 damage for each Future card you find there. Then, discard those Future cards and shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

card.name: Ciphermaniac's Codebreaking
card.effect: Search your deck for 2 cards, shuffle your deck, then put those cards on top of it in any order.

abilities.name: Initialization
abilities.effect: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, Pokémon with a Rule Box in play (both yours and your opponent's) have no Abilities, except for Future Pokémon. (Pokémon ex, Pokémon V, etc. have Rule Boxes.)

attacks.name: Volt Cyclone
attacks.effect: Move an Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

card.name: Clefable
card.description: It has an acute sense of hearing. It can easily hear a pin being dropped nearly 1,100 yards away.

attacks.name: Metronome
attacks.effect: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.
